name: utensil-desk
description: Research stocks through the Utensil Desk hosted MCP server using financials, company guidance, filings and fund ownership, with dated source evidence and explicit coverage gaps.

interface.longDescription:
SEC EDGAR data for US-listed companies above $1B market cap: filings by form, normalized financial facts (annual, quarterly and trailing twelve months), insider transactions from Forms 3, 4 and 5, Form 13F fund holdings and their quarter-to-quarter changes, Schedule 13D and 13G ownership reports, earnings report dates, per-share history and US economic release dates. Every value names the SEC filing it was read from, with a link to it.

Sign in with a Utensil Desk account. Every tool reads data; none changes anything.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand NBIS: its latest results, funding needs, outlook and risks.
Show this company's insider sales that the filings do not explain.
What revenue did this company report for its last eight quarters, and from which filing?
